module: 'Node Triangle Self Collision Detector' window of the live Vehicle Editor. The 'Start Analysis' button tests, for each collidable triangle, which vehicle nodes pass within a given radius (0.025 to 0.1 m, 0.025 m being the real collision radius) of the triangle. Ignored: NONCOLLIDABLE triangles, the triangle's nodes, nodes without collision or without selfCollision, coupler nodes or nodes with couplerTag/tag, and nodes in the same first group as a triangle vertex. The pairs found are printed to the console and drawn (orange sphere, green triangle, texts).
notes: O(triangles x nodes) complexity run in a single frame: can freeze the editor on a large vehicle.
The results are stored per vehicle ID in vehsResultData and included in onSerialize.

onVehicleEditorRenderJBeams.desc: Render hook emitted by editor_veMain: draws the analysis results of the current vehicle (node sphere, triangle, labels).

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: draws the window (radius slider, Start Analysis / Clear Results buttons).

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the open state and the radius (data.nodeCollisionRadius).
